$comment: Token/latency PROJECTION for the PyJWT pilot (initial proposals only). Measured inputs are exact counts of the real request content; everything else is a labelled estimate. NOTHING here is an observed token count, latency or cost -- those only exist in experiments/measured_runs/ after an operator runs the pilot (protocol.md §12). Consumed by the dev console Cost/Tokens panel.

measured_inputs.user_content_composition: evidence packet body + canonical rule schema (experiments/rule_schema.json), exactly as built by run_pyjwt_pilot.build_user_content()
measured_inputs.note: Exact counts of the real request content, recomputed 2026-09-24 for packet v0.2.0 + schema molt.rule.v2. tests/test_m0_artifacts.py fails if they drift.

token_estimation_method.description: Two disclosed heuristics over system prompt + user content: ~4 chars/token and ~1.33 tokens/word. JSON Schema text tokenises less efficiently than prose, so the char heuristic is taken as the high end.

output_token_assumption.basis: Assumption, not measurement: a 4-6 operation molt.rule.v2 bundle is ~300-800 visible output tokens; thinkingLevel=low adds an unknown number of thinking tokens (bounded by max_output_tokens=8192).

requests.repair_requests: 0 in the M0 pilot (repair sweep is M5)

monetary_cost.otherwise: unknown / not authorised: the zero-cost constraint forbids running on a billing-enabled project
monetary_cost.interpretation: Monetary cost is not an observable of the API; the runner records it as null unless the operator asserts Free Tier with --confirm-free-tier, and then records 0.0 labelled as an assertion.

superseded_historical_anthropic_projecti.status: superseded historical planning estimate, not active
superseded_historical_anthropic_projecti.superseded_reason: Zero-monetary-cost constraint adopted prior to observing any pilot generation.

not_estimated_at_all.latency_per_request: No basis without an observed request; unknown, not zero.
not_estimated_at_all.retry_rate: pilot_config.json sets a retry ceiling (policy), not an observed rate.
not_estimated_at_all.schema_validity_rate: The outcome the pilot exists to measure; cannot be projected.
